purpose_reasoning: Classified deployment rather than library: it ships no compiled artifact and exists to be PUBLISHED and inherited, in the same shape as the existing deployment module which is also pom-only and also misleads build_systems=maven into suggesting java skills.
responsibility: Publishes the downstream build parent a third-party deployer inherits from to produce an API Sheriff image carrying a custom context path. It carries no Java and builds no artifact: it declares the consumer-facing sheriff.context-path knob and its mapping onto the quarkus.sheriff-* carrier keys, the api-sheriff dependency plus the Quarkus platform BOM, the quarkus-maven-plugin binding with the main class pinned, and the native profile. Adopting a new API Sheriff release is a parent-version bump and nothing else.
responsibility_reasoning: pom-only module (packaging=pom, no src tree); quarkus-maven-plugin short-circuits on pom packaging, so the reactor walks it as a near no-op and all value is delivered by inheritance on the consumer side.
skills_by_profile_reasoning: Mirrors the existing pom-only deployment module rather than the java modules. The POM carries no Java source, so java/java-cui implementation skills would be resolved off build_systems=maven and be wrong here. module_testing is deliberately omitted: the parent has no tests of its own — its contract is asserted from api-sheriff by BuildParentContractTest, which lives in and is skill-resolved by that module.
